description: This file defines the 'Education' entity class for the OrangeHRM project, mapping to the 'ohrm_education' database table. It includes properties for 'id' and 'name', along with ORM mappings, constants, and methods for access and modification of these properties. The class also maintains a collection of associated EmployeeEducation entities via a ManyToMany relationship.
